text: Invest in shoes or sneakers — they let you move around faster. Buy them on the market and keep them in your inventory.
Use NFT lands with boosts (tiki statues, ice sculptures) as much as you can — they either yield more or produce faster.
You can craft boosts at a forge.
VIP greatly enhances gameplay and opens access to more earning possibilities.
A pet gives you further reach without moving your avatar, and has extra inventory slots — well worth having.
Always buy more clover seeds than you need — some become four-leaf clovers, so you'd end up short for your order.
Use tier 5 stoneshaping kilns and tier 3 stoves — they don't need a log to start, which saves resources.
Play twice a day: spend your energy in the morning, then sell and craft again when you log in later.
Before your real-life job, use all your energy (plus sleep energy, and sauna energy if you have it) on bulk crafts or mining, so when you log in later you have stock to sell.

These always sell, whatever your level, because they're used in lots of recipes and have few ingredients — worth it even if you buy the raw materials: jar of construction powder, stack of glass, batch of glass bottles, pile of planks, stack of metal bars (any), sack of grainbow flour, and tier 1 mining (water or space lands).
